newsitem.title: USA: Owens Corning buys balance of Knytex stake.
newsitem.headline: Owens Corning buys balance of Knytex stake.

text.p: Owens Corning said on Thursday it has acquired the balance of the equity in the Knytex Co, a maker of specialty reinforced glass fiber fabrics, from Hexcel Corp for undisclosed terms.
Knytex's facility in New Braunfels, Texas, will be combined with Owens Corning's specialty glass fiber fabrics plant in San Vicente, Spain, to form Owens Corning Fabrics.
The two units will have combined sales this year of more than $50 million, Owens Corning said.
Hexcel said in a separate statement that Knytex was no longer a strategically important part of its operations, but it still has retained rights to certain fabric technology.

Hexcel said it is upgrading its facilities in Seguin, Texas, and Lyon, France, by adding new weaving and finishing equipment for reinforcement fabrics used in aerospace, industrial and recreational markets.
